items.title: Hollinger COTD Don Nelson. 02-03 DAL was one of Nellie's best jobs. DAL went 60-22 & had the about the best offense relative to league since 88-89 (DAL had fewest TOs ever at the time). He also went full "grumpy old man" leading NBA in ejections & generally overreacting to calls.

items.title: The Sparks outscored the Valkyries 31-20 in the fourth quarter, but it wasn’t enough. LA fell to Golden State 84-78 and are now 12-19 on the season. Nneka Ogwumike led the Sparks in scoring with 16 points.
items.author: Edwin Garcia
items.body_excerpt: The Sparks outscored the Valkyries 31-20 in the fourth quarter, but it wasn’t enough. LA fell to Golden State 84-78 and are now 12-19 on the season. Nneka Ogwumike led the Sparks in scoring with 16 points.

items.title: Final: Valkyries 84, Sparks 78. Los Angeles fought back from down 19 in the fourth to give themselves a chance. Unfortunately, it fell short. Four Sparks scored in double figures. Sparks drop to 12-19. They play Phoenix at Galen Center on Tuesday.
